desc:
🩻 The most realistic ragdoll sandbox on Roblox!

Every ragdoll reacts like a real body: hit an arm and it hangs limp, shoot a leg and it limps away, break the bones and watch the skeleton show. Knock them down and they struggle back up… or crawl away if you took their legs.

🔫 ARSENAL – weapons: pistol, shotgun, katana, freeze ray, saw launcher, grenade launcher, lightsaber, the Force… and the brand new CHAINSAW 🪚
🧱 DESTRUCTION – kick ragdolls through brick walls, drive through everything
🚗 CARS – free pickup, or the Grinder Truck and Laser Truck
🎯 TRAPS – hydraulic press, grinder, wrecking ball, cannon, lava, trampolines, zero gravity
🤡 YOUR CLONE – your own avatar walks around the map… go meet yourself
🎁 DAILY REWARDS – log in every day for x2 coins and up to 5,000 coins
🏆 HALL OF FAME – top killers, most played and top supporters

Click = hit · Hold = charged hit · E = grab · G = throw · F = kick · V = free mouse

Updated often – favorite ⭐ the game so you don't miss new
